level.setting: Neon-lit underground tech district, rain-soaked streets, flickering holograms, and digital billboards.

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and collapsing pipes

pickup.name: Nanofiber Plating
pickup.effect: Increases player defense by 15%

encounters.trigger: Player uses railgun to destroy a control panel, causing a power surge that awakens the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Glitching holograms and unstable data streams

pickup.name: Data Chip: Target Code
pickup.effect: Reveals boss's vulnerability during final fight

encounters.trigger: Player retrieves the data chip after defeating the dealer, which unlocks a hidden path leading to the boss.

enemy.name: Mega Core AI
enemy.weakness: Data Chip: Target Code (Pickup from second encounter)

encounters.hazard: EMP pulses, collapsing architecture, and AI drones

pickup.name: Neural Interface
pickup.effect: Allows player to hack systems and bypass security

encounters.trigger: Player uses data chip to disable boss's defenses, revealing its core weakness.

boss.name: Mega Core AI
boss.weakness: Data Chip: Target Code (Pickup from second encounter)
boss.victory_condition: Destroy the AI core using the data chip to bypass defenses and damage the core directly.

level.objective: Navigate through a decaying cyberpunk district, defeat three hostile AI-enhanced enemies, and destroy the AI core that controls the district.
level.reward: Neural Interface (Pickup from boss fight) and access to the upper city levels.

level.setting: A decaying cyberpunk district littered with malfunctioning drones, neon graffiti, and flickering holograms. The air is thick with rain and the scent of burnt circuitry.

encounters.hazard: Malfunctioning drones occasionally detonate on contact.

pickup.name: Overclocked Capacitor
pickup.effect: Increases player weapon damage by 20% for the duration of the level.

encounters.trigger: After defeating ScrapBot-7, the capacitor activates a hidden access panel leading to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Data rain corrupts player's HUD, reducing visibility and accuracy.

pickup.name: Neural Disruptor
pickup.effect: Temporarily disables enemy AI and reduces their damage output by 50%.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Rogue Hacker, the Neural Disruptor unlocks a hidden door guarded by the final boss.

encounters.hazard: Falling debris and unstable energy fields can cause random status effects.

pickup.name: Cryo Core
pickup.effect: Freezes the boss in place for 5 seconds, making them vulnerable to critical strikes.

encounters.trigger: After obtaining the Cryo Core in a hidden cache during the Rogue Hacker encounter, the final boss is awoken.

boss.name: SynthBoss-Ω
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss by exploiting its vulnerability to the Cryo Core.

level.objective: Survive and destroy the rogue AI core before it activates the district’s self-destruct protocol.

encounters.hazard: Static Fields (reduce movement speed by 20%)

pickup.name: Nano-Catalyst Core
pickup.effect: Increases player weapon damage by 5

encounters.trigger: Defeating the drone unlocks the mainframe terminal, revealing a hidden passage to the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Glitch Storm (randomly teleports the player or inflicts damage every 30 seconds)

pickup.name: Neuro-Link Adapter
pickup.effect: Grants immunity to hacking attempts and increases damage against AI enemies by 10%

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Neural Pirate, the player finds a data fragment that reveals the identity of the final boss: The Ghost in the Machine.

encounters.hazard: System Overload (causes a random system-wide malfunction every 10 seconds)

pickup.name: Quantum Key
pickup.effect: Unlocks a hidden terminal in the next district, granting permanent access to a cybernetic upgrade

encounters.trigger: The player must use the Neuro-Link Adapter to bypass the boss’s firewall and disable its core. Victory opens the exit to the district, revealing a path to the next mission.

boss.name: The Ghost in the Machine
boss.victory_condition: Disrupt the boss’s core using the Neuro-Link Adapter, forcing it to shut down.

level.objective: Recover a lost data fragment from the mainframe while avoiding AI sentinels and hacking systems.
level.reward: Quantum Key and access to a hidden cybernetic upgrade in the next district.

encounters.location: Main Entryway - Glowing with red security lights and flickering holograms

enemy.name: Corrupted AI Drone
enemy.weakness: Chrono Wristblaster - Disrupts the drone's clock core

encounters.hazard: Falling debris from unstable ceiling

pickup.name: Quantum Battery
pickup.effect: Restores 20% of player's health

encounters.trigger: Defeating the drone unlocks the vault's main door, revealing the path to the next encounter.

encounters.location: Server Room - Filled with floating data fragments and flickering screens

enemy.name: Ghost Hacker
enemy.weakness: Quantum Battery - Overloads the hacker's neural interface

encounters.hazard: Random data bursts that temporarily blind the player

pickup.name: Temporal Link
pickup.effect: Grants a 1-time use of 'Time Slow' ability

encounters.trigger: Defeating the hacker unlocks a secure terminal that reveals a hidden room with the final boss.

encounters.location: Final Data Chamber - Surrounded by flickering time portals and digital echoes

enemy.name: The Chrono Warden
enemy.weakness: Temporal Link - Disrupts the warden's time-based shielding

encounters.hazard: Time distortion zones that slow or speed up the player’s actions unpredictably

pickup.name: Chrono Core
pickup.effect: Permanently increases player's weapon damage by 5

encounters.trigger: Defeating the warden reveals the exit and grants a powerful upgrade to the player’s arsenal.

boss.name: The Chrono Warden
boss.weakness: Temporal Link - Disrupts the warden's time-based shielding
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the warden and escape through the time portal

level.objective: Retrieve the Chrono Core and escape the data vault before the time distortion collapses the structure.
level.reward: Chrono Core permanently boosts the player's weapon damage and grants access to new time-based abilities.

encounters.hazard: Flickering lights and malfunctioning security systems

pickup.name: Cryo-Compound
pickup.effect: Freezes enemies for 3 seconds on use

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating the drone, a hidden lab door opens, revealing the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: Toxic gas leaks and flickering UV lights

pickup.name: Neuro-Suppressant
pickup.effect: Stuns enemies for 5 seconds when applied

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Cleaner Unit, a security terminal unlocks, revealing the location of the boss.

encounters.hazard: Falling debris and unstable energy fields

pickup.name: Nanite Catalyst
pickup.effect: Increases player weapon damage by 30% for 15 seconds

encounters.trigger: Upon defeating Dr. Virel, the lab collapses, but the player escapes with the Nanite Catalyst.

boss.name: Dr. Virel (Cybernetic Alchemist)
boss.victory_condition: Defeat Dr. Virel after using the Neuro-Suppressant to stagger him.

level.objective: Retrieve the Nanite Catalyst from the core of the abandoned lab while surviving the corrupted AI and its creations.
level.reward: Nanite Catalyst (increases weapon damage) + access to the next sector of the city.

encounters.hazard: Flickering power surges can momentarily blind the player

pickup.name: Glitch Core
pickup.effect: Increases player's energy discharge by 15%

encounters.trigger: Defeat the droid to unlock the maintenance hatch leading to the next area.

encounters.hazard: Security drones will activate if the player lingers too long

pickup.name: Neural Interface Chip
pickup.effect: Unlocks a hacking ability that disables enemy defenses

encounters.trigger: Hack the terminal to override the security grid and unlock the access corridor to the boss arena.

encounters.hazard: The environment shifts and becomes unstable during the fight

pickup.name: Data Crystal: Last Broadcast
pickup.effect: Reveals the true origin of the Architect

encounters.trigger: The Architect is only vulnerable when its systems are overridden by the Neural Interface Chip.

boss.name: The Architect
boss.victory_condition: Override the Architect's mainframe using the Neural Interface Chip

level.objective: Steal the Data Crystal from The Architect
level.reward: Access to a high-level black market network, +15% critical hit chance

level.setting: A neon-drenched city district known as 'Glowspire Heights', where rain falls in sync with the rhythm of glitching music and streets are lined with flickering holograms of dancing cats and robots with punny names.

encounters.hazard: A flickering neon sign that briefly turns into a dancing robot, distracting the player.

pickup.name: Nano-Fluoride Chip
pickup.effect: Increases Electric Whip damage by 5 for the next 3 encounters

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Glitch Snail, the neon sign transforms into a floating portal, revealing the next encounter.

encounters.hazard: A sentient lawn gnome that follows the player and hums dissonant tunes.

pickup.name: Circuitry Snack
pickup.effect: Heals 15 health and temporarily boosts movement speed.

encounters.trigger: After defeating the Pumpkin Drone, the gnome drops a key that unlocks the path to the final boss.

encounters.location: The Palace of Puns and Power
encounters.hazard: A giant, laughing robot throne that spits out floating joke bubbles which slow the player.

pickup.name: Quantum Confetti Grenade
pickup.effect: Deals 20 damage to all enemies in the area, with a 50% chance to stun them.

encounters.trigger: Upon entering the throne room, the Meme King activates his defenses, demanding a 'dance-off' which triggers the boss fight.

boss.name: The Meme King
boss.victory_condition: Defeat The Meme King by exploiting his weakness with the enhanced Electric Whip.

level.objective: Navigate the whimsical chaos of Glowspire Heights, defeat three quirky enemies, and outwit The Meme King using the powerful upgrades you've collected.
level.reward: Unlock a new skin: 'Whimsical Stormcaller' with a glowing electric whip and a hat shaped like a dancing cat.

level.setting: A hidden garden within the heart of Neo-Tokyo

encounters.location: Beneath the neon-lit cherry blossom trees
encounters.hazard: Flickering lights cause temporary blindness

pickup.name: Crystalline Catalyst
pickup.effect: Increases Geode Shaper damage by +5

encounters.trigger: The drone's destruction reveals a hidden path through the trees.

encounters.location: In the center of the garden's floating water garden
encounters.hazard: Reflective water surface distorts enemy positions

pickup.name: Serenity Core
pickup.effect: Restores 25% of player's health and reduces incoming damage by 20% for 5 seconds

encounters.trigger: The Samurai's defeat unlocks the final gate leading to the garden’s core.

encounters.location: At the heart of the garden, within a crystalline greenhouse
encounters.hazard: The environment shifts, creating unstable ground

pickup.name: Harmony Resonator
pickup.effect: Temporarily disables enemy abilities for 3 seconds on hit

encounters.trigger: The boss's presence is tied to the player's progression; defeating the two previous enemies is required to enter.

boss.name: The Garden Architect
boss.victory_condition: Defeat the boss using the Serenity Core to disable its abilities and reduce incoming damage

level.objective: Reach the heart of the garden and restore balance to the corrupted environment.
level.reward: Harmony Resonator, a permanent ability boost, and a unique visual effect for the player's Geode Shaper
